name: dev-lifecycle
description: End-to-end development lifecycle commands — idea → classified GitHub issue on a Projects board → worktree → PR → squash-merge. Ships /intake, /triage, /start, /preflight, /open-pr (config-driven via a per-repo .github/dev-workflow.yml). Auto-flags sensitive diffs for human review; reviews stay local; merging auto-deploys. Pairs with the hikmahlabs/project-template repo for the GitHub layer + bootstrap script.
